name: Forest floor
text: Plain ground with no intensity. Creatures nearby change it; on its own it only grows things that need nothing.

name: Stony ground
text: Stone pushes spikes of rock up through the grass: gravel at first, tall spires at its strongest.

name: Dug earth
text: Depth opens patches of bare earth with roots, and burrow holes as it deepens. It hides things underground.

name: Damp ground
text: Damp darkens and soaks the grass, from dew to puddles. Water slowly seeps outward and runs downhill.

name: Glowing ground
text: Glow scatters motes and glowing moss. Faint by day, bright at night, and bright in deep ground even by day.

name: Flowering ground
text: Bloom fills the grass with flowers that open in the morning, peak at midday and close at dusk.

name: Lush grass
text: Verdure thickens the grass into tall growth where small things can hide.

name: Shallow pool
text: Where Damp gathers in dug ground it pools into shallow water, joined into ponds with neighbouring pools.

name: Mossy bank
text: Stone, Damp and Verdure together grow moss over ground and rock, and bugs gather there.

name: Wild meadow
text: Bloom and Verdure together make a tangle of flowers in long grass, where plants grow fast.

name: Foxfire Fen
text: Damp and Glow together: wet ground lit by foxfire, a cold green glow that brightens at night.

name: Rain Garden
text: Damp and Bloom together: dewy flowers between little puddles, at their best in the rain.

name: Dripstone Ledge
text: Damp and Stone together: slick wet rock that drips, where shelf mushrooms cling.

name: Fernbrake
text: Damp and Verdure together: a misty thicket of ferns that draws finds in.

name: Crystal Outcrop
text: Glow and Stone together: crystals push up through the rock and catch the light.

name: Lantern Hollow
text: Glow and Depth together: a dark dip in the ground with glowing specks, brightest at night.

name: Moonlit Garden
text: Glow and Bloom together: pale flowers that open their light after dark.

name: Wisp Thicket
text: Glow and Verdure together: long grass where little wisps of light drift at night.

name: Rock Garden
text: Bloom and Stone together: flowers growing out of cracks in the rock, open in the sun.

name: Sunken Garden
text: Bloom and Depth together: flowers growing down in a hollow of dug earth.

name: Geode Bed
text: Stone and Depth together: a cracked hollow of exposed stone, full of geodes.

name: Overgrown Rocks
text: Stone and Verdure together: ivy and moss creeping over boulders.

name: Root Tangle
text: Depth and Verdure together: exposed roots knotted through the dug earth.

name: Glowworm Grotto
text: Damp, Glow and Depth at their strongest: a dripping grotto lit by glowworms. Legendary ground.

name: Heartwood Grove
text: Bloom, Verdure and Depth at their strongest: an old grove around deep roots. Legendary ground.

name: Heartstone Vein
text: Glow, Stone and Depth at their strongest: a glowing vein of crystal deep in the rock. Legendary ground.

name: Amethyst Seep
text: Damp, Glow and Stone at their strongest: violet crystals in seeping water. Legendary ground.

name: Treeline
text: The dense forest around your clearing. Nothing grows there for you yet; the clearing pushes it back as your land develops.
